title: Dulce de Leche
hookLine: Argentina-inspired dulce de leche with 4 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Dulce de Leche
steps.instructionTemplate: Combine Ingredients: In a large, heavy-bottomed pot, mix the milk, sugar, and baking soda. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly to prevent burning. Thicken: Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until the mixture becomes thick and caramel-colored, about 1-2 hours. Incorporate {m53137_1} and {m53137_2} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure milk first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build Flavor: Dulce de Leche
steps.instructionTemplate: Flavor: Stir in the vanilla extract. Cool: Let the dulce de leche cool, then transfer to a jar. It will thicken further as it cools.

steps.title: Transfer, Smooth Top & Add Garnish
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour or press the mixture evenly into your prepared dish, smoothing the surface with a spatula. Scatter {m53137_3} and {m53137_4} evenly across the top and press gently so it adheres cleanly.

steps.title: Chill Firm, Slice & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Stir continuously and keep the heat low to prevent the milk from burning and sticking to the bottom of the pan. A drop of vanilla extract added at the end of cooking enhances the flavor.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Measure aromatics and syrups before heating so timing stays crisp and your glaze hits glossy perfection.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 8 mins!
